exposure: Postoperative enhanced recovery nursing plan as a rooming-in practice
cohort: Women with preeclampsia who underwent a cesarean section were selected from an obstetrics department of a Class A tertiary hospital in Nanjing, China.
finding: The implementation of a postoperative enhanced recovery nursing intervention significantly improved maternal self-efficacy, breastfeeding efficacy, anxiety, pain, DVT prevention compliance, and blood pressure control in women with preeclampsia after cesarean section compared to routine care.
